svg.title: codemap-py plugin architecture
svg.desc: How codemap-py builds a structural Python index, answers queries through CLI and skill adapters, and records hook telemetry
svg.text: scan once, query a local structural index, from CLI, Claude and Codex skills — single-agent, no Agent() spawns
unlabeled arrow = block finished, next block starts · pills name every condition

text.tspan: each engine takes its own index lease
never pushes Git or edits caches

g.text: HOOKS · optional, not needed to index or query

text.tspan: no logs: exit 1 · anon failure: exit 4

svg.text: INDEX LIFECYCLE — build, serve, detect staleness, refresh, current again (loops until no change set remains)

g.text: What starts a refresh, and what bounds it
Where a stop, question or skip can change the flow
What the picture does not promise

svg.text: Non-normative overview of how the plugin fits together. The plugin source and contract docs win on any disagreement:
README.md, DEVELOPMENT.md, shared/capability-contract.md, claude-skills/*/SKILL.md, codex-skills/*/SKILL.md, hooks/*.json.
Update this file in the same commit that changes a component, process boundary, gate or hook it shows.
